description: Land the plan `visimark_fmt` returned: splice the document's computed cells and anchors, and write the generated artifacts it named. Refused if the document changed since the plan was computed, and refused entirely unless the operator started the server with `--allow-write` and the host declared a root.

path.description: The document to write. There is nothing to apply to a string.

plan.description: The result of `visimark_fmt`, unedited apart from dropping entries you rejected.

name: visimark_fmt_apply
title: Apply a VisiMark repair
